title: Threads Went From Zero to Beating X
source: Sources: Meta investor disclosures and reporting by TechCrunch, Social Media Today and eMarketer on Threads MAU (130M end of 2023, 275M Q4 2024, 400M Aug 2025, and passing X in daily mobile users by Jan 2026); Bluesky's own published user-count updates (41.4M by Dec 2025). 2026 values are conservative extrapolations since neither platform has published a full 2026 total.
